items.description: +1 damage, adds a chance to shoot fear tears.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 伤害 +1；有概率发射恐惧泪弹。

items.description: Prevents curses. Grants one Black Heart. Increases the chance for a Devil Room or Angel Room to appear.
items.unlock: Donate 150 Coins to the Donation Machine
items.descriptionZh: 免疫楼层诅咒，获得 1 颗黑心，并提高恶魔房或天使房出现概率。
items.unlockZh: 向捐款机累计捐赠 150 枚硬币。

items.description: Tears start out massive with high damage, and then shrink down and become weaker over a short range.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 泪弹刚射出时巨大且伤害高，随后快速缩小、减弱，适合近距离攻击。

items.description: Grants one Black Heart. Upon taking damage that reduces Isaac's health to one heart or less, deals damage to all enemies in the room. Increases the damage of Black Hearts and The Necronomicon-like effects by 40.
items.quote: Evil up. Your enemies will pay!
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得 1 颗黑心；受伤后生命不多于 1 颗心时，对全房间敌人造成伤害。黑心和死灵之书类效果的伤害增加 40。

items.description: Has the same effect as the rune or soul stone currently held by Isaac. The charge time is based on the power of the rune.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 复制当前携带的符文或魂石效果；所需充能随复制对象而变化。

items.description: Spawns an orbital familiar that blocks enemy shots. Upon taking damage, the familiar will pursue enemies for the rest of the room, dealing 22.5 damage per second.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得可阻挡弹幕的绕身苍蝇；受伤后，它会在本房间内主动追击敌人。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and blocks enemy projectiles. Upon blocking a shot, it has a chance of triggering The Necronomicon effect.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得阻挡弹幕的枯骨跟班；成功挡弹时有概率触发全房间伤害。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and drips a trail of slow creep, spawning 1-2 Blue Spiders after each room.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得沿途留下减速液体的跟班；清理房间后生成 1–2 只蓝蜘蛛。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that fires lasers at any enemy in its line of sight and moves based on the direction Isaac is firing tears.
items.quote: We worked out all the kinks
items.unlock: Complete Computer Savvy (challenge #16)
items.descriptionZh: 获得可用射击方向控制移动的机器人跟班，向视线上的敌人发射激光。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that spawns a Blue Fly when Isaac shoots. It can only have one Fly at a time.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得射击时生成蓝苍蝇的跟班；它同时只能维持一只尚未出击的苍蝇。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac, leaving blood creep on the ground.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得沿途留下伤害性血迹的无头跟班。

items.description: Spawns a leech familiar that chases enemies, dealing ~3 damage per second. Heals a Half Red Heart whenever Leech kills an enemy.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得主动追击敌人的水蛭；水蛭击杀敌人时恢复半颗红心。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that drops a Heart, coin, Bomb, or Key every 5-6 rooms.
items.unlock: Defeat The Lamb as  Eden
items.descriptionZh: 获得每清理 5–6 个房间掉落心、硬币、炸弹或钥匙的袋子跟班。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that flies around the room in a zig-zag pattern and explodes on contact with an enemy. Respawns after ten seconds.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得在房间内弹跳移动的苍蝇，撞到敌人后爆炸，约 10 秒后重生。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that charges forward when shooting tears and explodes upon contact with an enemy, damaging and poisoning them. The familiar respawns after a few seconds.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得射击时向前冲出的脑跟班，撞到敌人后爆炸并施加中毒；数秒后重生。

items.description: When hit, spawns a quickly orbiting attack fly similar to Forever alone for the current room that deals high damage.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 受伤时，本房间内生成一只高速绕身的攻击苍蝇，造成较高接触伤害。

items.description: Grants a familiar that charges a thin Brimstone laser while Isaac is shooting.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得硫磺火跟班，随角色射击蓄力，随后发射细血激光。

items.description: Isaac himself is now immune to all damage, and a heart familiar follows him. If the heart is hurt, Isaac is hurt. The heart charges up as Isaac shoots, firing 8 blood shots, knocking back enemies, and leaving a puddle of creep when released.
items.unlock: Defeat Isaac as  The Lost
items.descriptionZh: 角色本体不再承受伤害，伤害改由尾随的心脏承担。射击可为心脏蓄力，松开后发射血弹、击退敌人并留下液体。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that chases down enemies, dealing 4 damage per second and inflicting fear.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得自动追击敌人的幽灵跟班，造成接触伤害并使敌人恐惧。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and collects Red Hearts. For every 1½ Red Hearts collected, Dark Bum will give a reward.
items.quote: He wants to take your life
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得收集红心的乞丐跟班，每收集相当于 1.5 颗红心的数量后给予奖励。

items.description: Spawns a large, slow-moving orbital familiar that blocks enemy shots and deals 30 damage per second to enemies. Reduces the speed other orbitals rotate at.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得大型缓慢绕身苍蝇，阻挡弹幕并造成接触伤害；其他绕身物也会转得更慢。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that wanders randomly, occasionally spawning Blue Spiders. Briefly charms enemies on contact.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得随机游走的蜘蛛跟班，间歇生成蓝蜘蛛，接触敌人可短暂魅惑。

items.description: Spawns a Mulligan familiar that wanders randomly. Enemies will attack the Mulligan if it's closer.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得随机游走的诱饵跟班；敌人更接近它时会转而攻击它。

items.description: Isaac jumps in the direction he is currently moving, allowing travel over obstacles and enemies.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 向当前移动方向跳跃，可越过障碍物和敌人。

items.description: Combines the effects of D4, The D6, and D20. Combines the effects of D1, D4, The D6, D7, D8, D10, D12, and D20.
items.unlock: Complete the Boss Rush as  The Lost
items.descriptionZh: 同时触发一面骰、四面骰、六面骰、七面骰、八面骰、十面骰、十二面骰和二十面骰的效果。
items.unlockZh: 使用游魂完成首领车轮战。

items.description: Rerolls all of Isaac's passive items.
items.unlock: Blow up 30 Slot Machine
items.descriptionZh: 重置角色持有的全部被动道具。
items.unlockZh: 累计炸毁 30 台老虎机。

items.description: Re-rolls all monsters in the room. Replaces all monsters in the room with weaker monsters.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 将房间内的非首领怪物替换为较弱的怪物。

items.description: Copies the effect of the card or rune currently held by Isaac. Copies the effect of the card currently held by Isaac. The charge time is based on the power of the card.
items.unlock: Defeat Isaac as  Eden
items.descriptionZh: 复制当前携带的卡牌效果，所需充能随卡牌变化；不复制符文效果。

items.description: Gives the effect of Treasure Map, The Compass, or Blue Map for the duration of the current floor. If all effects are active, X-Ray Vision is provided for the floor instead. Highlights any Tinted Rocks and rocks with Crawl Space in the room.
items.unlock: Defeat Satan as  Eden
items.descriptionZh: 本层随机获得藏宝图、指南针或蓝地图的一种效果；三者齐全时改为 X 光透视。还会标记当前房间的标记石头与夹层石头。

items.description: Spawns 1-4 Blue Spiders that deal 2.5× Isaac's damage to enemies. Spawns 4-8 Blue Spiders that deal 2× Isaac's damage to enemies.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 生成 4–8 只友方蓝蜘蛛，伤害为角色伤害的 2 倍。

items.description: Throws out a flame that damages everything in its path, diminishing in size as it hits enemies or blocks shots.
items.unlock: Donate 400 Coins to the Donation Machine
items.descriptionZh: 向前投出火焰；火焰伤害敌人或阻挡弹幕后逐渐缩小。
items.unlockZh: 向捐款机累计捐赠 400 枚硬币。

items.description: When at full health, up to 4 extra Red Hearts can be stored in The Jar. Activating drops the stored hearts on the ground.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 满红心时可储存最多 4 颗额外红心；使用后将储存的红心放回地面。

items.description: Turns all non-boss monsters in the room into Poop. Instantly kills poop-themed bosses. Floods the current room.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 将房间内非首领怪物变成大便，立即击杀大便主题首领，并使房间积水。

items.description: Gives one Black Heart. Replaces the boss room item on the current floor with a Devil Deal.
items.quote: Reusable evil... but at what cost?
items.unlock: Defeat Isaac as  Azazel
items.descriptionZh: 获得 1 颗黑心；将本层首领房奖励替换为恶魔交易。
items.unlockZh: 使用阿撒泻勒击败以撒。

items.description: Fires a powerful Brimstone beam in four cardinal directions, much like Krampus shoots. Fires a powerful Brimstone beam in four cardinal directions, much like Krampus shoots, with a 50% chance to rotate all beams around Isaac 90 degrees.
items.unlock: Defeat Krampus
items.descriptionZh: 向上下左右发射硫磺火激光，有 50% 概率让激光围绕角色旋转 90 度。

items.description: Isaac farts and knocks back nearby enemies and projectiles. Enemies pushed into walls or obstacles take 12 damage.
items.unlock: Destroy 100 Poops
items.descriptionZh: 放屁击退附近敌人和弹幕；敌人撞到墙壁或障碍物会受到 12 点伤害。

items.description: Uses 1 Penny to deal damage to all enemies in the room.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 消耗 1 枚硬币，对房间内所有敌人造成伤害。

items.description: Converts two Soul Hearts or Black Hearts into one filled Red Heart Container. Converts one Soul Heart or Black Heart into one filled Red Heart Container.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 将 1 颗魂心或黑心转换为 1 个填满的红心容器。

items.description: Spawns specific pickups or items depending on the floor it is used on. Disappears after use.
items.unlock: Defeat The Lamb as  Lazarus
items.descriptionZh: 根据当前楼层生成特定的道具或掉落物；使用后消失。

items.description: Gives invulnerability and increased speed for six seconds, but removes the ability to shoot tears.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 持续 6 秒获得无敌和移速提升，但期间不能射击。

items.description: -0.3 Speed. Isaac builds speed while in a room with enemies. At max speed, he gains the My Little Unicorn effect for 5 seconds.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 移速 -0.3；战斗中移速逐渐增加，到达上限时获得持续 5 秒的独角兽冲撞效果。

items.description: +0.25 Speed. Running into enemies while at a high speed will deal damage. Prevents Isaac from taking contact damage while moving at high speed.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 移速 +0.25；高速移动时碰撞敌人可造成伤害，并免疫对应的接触伤害。

items.description: Adds 3 Soul Hearts. Grants The Wafer effect for the current room after taking damage.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得 3 颗魂心；受伤后，本房间内获得圣饼的减伤效果。

items.description: Isaac can destroy rocks by walking into them.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 可以通过行走踩碎石头。

items.description: Adds a chance to give a shield that nullifies all incoming damage for 10 seconds upon taking damage. Also converts bad pills into good pills.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 受伤时有概率获得持续 10 秒的无敌护盾；负面药丸变为正面药丸。

items.description: Gives 6 Coins, 6 Bombs, and 6 Keys and balances out all attributes.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得 6 枚硬币、6 枚炸弹和 6 把钥匙，并平衡角色的各项主要属性。

items.description: Grants poison tears, which deal damage over time when inflicted.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 泪弹必定附带中毒效果，持续伤害敌人。

items.description: Increases speed by +0.2 and grants piercing tears.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 移速 +0.2；泪弹可穿透敌人。

items.description: Adds 1 Red Heart Container, gives +0.5 Damage, +0.1 Speed, +1.5 Range, and -1.0 Tear Delay, and gives 1 Bomb, Penny, and Key. Adds 1 Red Heart Container, gives +0.5 Damage, +0.1 Speed, +0.75 Range, and +0.5 Fire Rate, and gives 1 Bomb, Penny, and Key.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 增加 1 个红心容器；伤害 +0.5、移速 +0.1、射程 +0.75、射速 +0.5，并获得硬币、炸弹、钥匙各 1 个。

items.description: A trail of blue creep is left behind Isaac, which damages enemies. The creep scales with damage and inherits most tear effects.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 移动时留下蓝色伤害液体；液体伤害随角色伤害变化，并继承大多数泪弹效果。

items.description: -1 Tear Delay, adds knock-back shots and increases tear size. +0.5 Fire Rate, adds knock-back shots and increases tear size.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 射速 +0.5；泪弹变大，击退效果增强。

items.description: Doubles damage, halves tears stat, and greatly reduces shot speed. Doubles damage, 0.66x tears multiplier, and greatly reduces shot speed.
items.quote: DMG up, tears + shot speed down
items.unlock: Complete the Boss Rush as  Eve
items.descriptionZh: 伤害翻倍，射速倍率 ×0.66，弹速显著降低。
items.unlockZh: 使用夏娃完成首领车轮战。

items.description: Upon death, respawns Isaac as Dark Judas with two Black Hearts in the previous room.
items.unlock: Complete the Boss Rush as  Judas
items.descriptionZh: 死亡后在上一个房间以黑犹大的身份复活，拥有 2 颗黑心。
items.unlockZh: 使用犹大完成首领车轮战。

items.description: Gives one Red Heart Container and doubles the healing provided by Red Hearts. Also heals 1 Red Heart when obtained.
items.unlock: Complete the Boss Rush as  Magdalene
items.descriptionZh: 增加 1 个红心容器并恢复 1 颗红心；红心掉落物的治疗量翻倍。
items.unlockZh: 使用抹大拉完成首领车轮战。

items.description: Grants a shield that negates the first instance of damage taken from a hostile source once per room.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 每个房间获得一次护盾，可抵消一次来自敌对来源的伤害。

items.description: Destroys rocks upon contact with Isaac. Adds one Red Heart container and lowers Speed.
items.quote: HP up + speed down + you feel stompy
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 增加 1 个红心容器，降低移速；可以通过行走踩碎石头。

items.description: Pickups, trinkets, and monsters are magnetically attracted to Isaac's tears.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 泪弹会像磁铁一样吸引掉落物、饰品和敌人。

items.description: Grants charged tears that can be fired in a tight burst. Getting hit while charging will teleport Isaac to another room.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 可蓄力连射一串泪弹；蓄力期间受伤会被传送到其他房间。

items.description: Tears leave a small, short lasting pool of creep on impact or when their range is depleted.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 泪弹碰撞或落地后留下短暂的小片伤害液体。

items.description: Spawns a conjoined familiar which chases enemies close to Isaac, dealing ~6.43 damage per second.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得与角色相连的跟班，自动追击附近敌人并造成接触伤害。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that slowly floats around the room on a zig-zag pattern and shoots normal tears in the same direction as Isaac. Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and fires tears in random cardinal directions that copy Isaac's tears and tear effects and scale with damage.
items.unlock: Complete the Boss Rush as  Cain
items.descriptionZh: 获得向随机方向射击的眼球跟班；泪弹继承角色的特殊效果，伤害随角色伤害变化。
items.unlockZh: 使用该隐完成首领车轮战。

items.description: Spawns a controllable familiar that deals 37.5 damage per second on touch. It can be moved using the shooting directional keys
items.unlock: Complete the Boss Rush as  ???
items.descriptionZh: 获得可用射击方向控制的苍蝇跟班，持续伤害接触到的敌人。

items.description: Attaches a ball and chain to Isaac that pulls behind him that damages enemies, blocks shots, and destroys most Obstacles.
items.unlock: Complete the Boss Rush as  Samson
items.descriptionZh: 拖着一颗铁球，可伤害敌人、阻挡弹幕并破坏大多数障碍物。
items.unlockZh: 使用参孙完成首领车轮战。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that copies the tears of Isaac's other familiars.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得模仿其他跟班泪弹的跟班。

items.description: Fires 8 tears around Isaac, which retain the damage, range, shot speed, and special tear effects of his tears. Each tear shot by Isaac increases item charge by one. Tears from this item have a +5 flat damage bonus.
items.unlock: Defeat Isaac as  Isaac
items.descriptionZh: 向周围发射 8 颗继承角色属性和特殊效果的泪弹，每颗额外增加 5 点伤害；角色每次射击都会为本道具充能。

items.description: Teleports Isaac to the Secret Room, Super Secret Room, Treasure Room, or I AM ERROR.
items.unlock: Complete the Boss Rush as  Eden
items.descriptionZh: 随机传送到隐藏房、超级隐藏房、宝物房或错误房。
items.unlockZh: 使用伊甸完成首领车轮战。

items.description: Turns Isaac's head into a stationary familiar for the current room which fires tears automatically. Isaac's body also shoots a controllable fountain of blood shots for the room.
items.unlock: Die 100 times
items.descriptionZh: 本房间内头部留在原地自动射击，身体仍可移动，并向控制方向喷出血弹。

items.description: Grants a brief moment of invincibility when the charge bar hits zero. Isaac begins taking damage if the item is held any longer. Isaac creates beams of light when touching enemies while invulnerable, and creates a powerful 4-way beam if blocking damage exactly as the invincibility starts.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 长按使用，在充能降至零时获得短暂无敌；继续按住会受伤。无敌期间接触敌人产生光柱，精准挡下伤害可触发四向强力光束。

items.description: If Isaac has half a red heart or no red hearts after taking damage, he gains a shield that nullifies all types of damage for 5 seconds. Allows entrance into Chest. Also allows access to Home.
items.unlock: Defeat Isaac 5 times
items.descriptionZh: 受伤后红心不多于半颗时，获得持续 5 秒的无敌护盾；用于进入宝箱层，也可用于开启回家路线。

items.description: If Isaac has half a red heart or no red hearts after taking damage, all enemies in the room take significant damage. Allows entrance into the Dark Room. +1 Damage and also allows access to Home.
items.unlock: Defeat Satan 5 times
items.descriptionZh: 伤害 +1；受伤后红心不多于半颗时，对全房间敌人造成伤害；用于进入暗室，也可用于开启回家路线。

items.description: Instead of firing tears, Isaac controls one floating tear that hover over obstacles. This tear deals constant damage when held in place over an enemy.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 用一颗可自由控制、悬浮于障碍物之上的泪弹替代普通射击；停留在敌人身上会持续造成伤害。

items.description: Tears are smaller and do much less damage, but fire in very rapid succession.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 泪弹变小、单发伤害大幅降低，但射速极大提高。

items.description: Grants homing tears with a damaging halo. +0.5 Damage, -0.3 Tears -0.3 Shot Speed, +0.8 Tear Falling Speed, and +1.2 Range. Grants homing tears with a damaging halo. +0.5 Damage, -0.3 Tears, and -0.3 Shot Speed.
items.unlock: Earn all   6 /   9 (except Ultra Greed) /   10 /   12 Completion Marks on Hard mode as  The Lost
items.descriptionZh: 获得带伤害光环的追踪泪弹；伤害 +0.5、射速 -0.3、弹速 -0.3。
items.unlockZh: 使用游魂取得全部困难模式通关标记。

items.unlock: Defeat Isaac as  Lazarus
items.descriptionZh: 死亡后原地以复活的拉撒路身份复活，红心容器减少 1 个，获得贫血效果及伤害 +0.5；进入下一层后变为拉撒路。

items.description: Reveals the entire map, including all special rooms and Secret Rooms.

items.description: Adds 3 Red Heart Containers.

items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)

items.description: Grants one Black Heart, +5.25 range, +0.5 tear falling speed, +0.16 shot speed. Grants one Black Heart, +2.5 range, +0.16 shot speed.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得 1 颗黑心，射程 +2.5，弹速 +0.16。

items.description: Grants +0.3 speed, reduces Isaac's size, and gives a random pill.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 移速 +0.3，体型缩小，并生成一颗随机药丸。

items.quote: HP + tears up + shot speed down

items.unlock: Donate 33 Coins to the Greed Donation Machine
items.descriptionZh: 约有一半概率生成一枚硬币，也约有一半概率无事发生；可能生成高面值硬币。

items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)

items.unlockZh: 完成挑战 19，击败洛基兄弟，并解锁犹大。

items.unlockZh: 使用莉莉丝击败究极贪婪。

items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 伤害 +1.5；泪弹变为击退力更强的钉子。

items.unlock: Defeat Hush as  The Lost
items.descriptionZh: 获得绕身守护者，吸引并阻挡弹幕、造成高额接触伤害；同房间内挡下 10 发弹幕后掉落永恒之心。

items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)

items.description: +5 Bombs. Isaac's bombs explode into 2-4 tiny bombs.
items.quote: We put bombs in your bombs!
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得 5 枚炸弹；炸弹爆炸后分裂为 2–4 枚小炸弹。

items.description: +5 Bombs. Bombs stick to enemies and spawn 2-4 Blue Spiders if they kill an enemy. They also leave a long-lasting puddle of slowing white creep.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得 5 枚炸弹；炸弹会黏住敌人，击杀后生成 2–4 只蓝蜘蛛，并留下持续较久的白色减速液体。

items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得幽灵泪弹并增加射程；泪弹穿过房间边界后，会从另一侧继续飞出。

items.descriptionZh: 射速 +0.7，射程 +2.5；拾取时生成 3 颗随机类型的心。

items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 蜘蛛类敌人不再主动攻击角色，也不再造成接触伤害。

items.descriptionZh: 获得 5 枚硬币；锁门、金箱子和钥匙方块改为消耗 1 枚硬币开启。

items.descriptionZh: 获得收集硬币并逐级成长的乞丐宝：长出身体、学会射击，最终追击敌人并造成接触伤害。

items.description: Re-rolls all Rocks and Metal Blocks in the current room into other random obstacles. Re-rolls most types of Obstacles in the current room into other random obstacles.
items.unlock: Defeat Hush as  Cain
items.descriptionZh: 将当前房间内大多数障碍物随机变成其他类型的障碍物。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and collects Keys for himself, giving random Chests in return.

items.descriptionZh: 获得收集钥匙的乞丐跟班，返还随机箱子。

items.descriptionZh: 获得符文袋跟班，清理一定数量的房间后掉落随机符文。

items.descriptionZh: 获得发射追踪泪弹的天使跟班，每颗泪弹造成 10 点伤害。

items.unlock: Defeat Hush as  Judas

items.description: Isaac's tears have a chance to stick to enemies and explode.

Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac. Double tapping the fire button launches it forward, causing it to reroll the first monster or pickup it hits.

items.description: Re-rolls Isaac's damage, tears, range, and speed.

items.descriptionZh: 随机重置伤害、射速、射程和移速。

items.descriptionZh: 击杀敌人时，有概率在其位置生成黑色伤害环；触发概率受幸运影响。

items.description: Grants two Black Hearts. While Isaac has no red hearts, grants flight and periodically grants an invincibility shield for a few seconds.
items.unlock: Defeat Hush as  Lazarus

items.unlockZh: 使用该隐击败究极贪婪。

items.description: Isaac's damage increases for the current room each time he kills an enemy.
items.unlock: Defeat Ultra Greed as  Samson
items.descriptionZh: 每击杀一个敌人，提高本房间内的伤害。

items.description: After taking damage a certain amount of times, a permanent demonic familiar spawns.

items.description: Consumes Isaac's currently held trinket and applies its effect permanently.
items.unlock: Defeat Mom's Heart or It Lives! on Hard mode as  Apollyon
items.descriptionZh: 熔掉当前携带的饰品，永久保留其效果。
items.unlockZh: 使用亚玻伦击败妈妈的心脏或它还活着（困难模式）。

items.description: Doubles Isaac's Blue Flies and Blue Spiders, or spawns one if Isaac has none. Converts pickups in the current room into Blue Flies or Blue Spiders.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 将当前房间的掉落物变为蓝苍蝇或蓝蜘蛛，并使现有友方蓝苍蝇、蓝蜘蛛翻倍；没有时也会生成一个。

items.description: Displaces enemy sprites for the current room, randomly increases one stat and decreases another.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 本房间内打乱敌人的显示位置，并随机提高一项属性、降低另一项属性。

items.description: Transforms Isaac into a random character and removes the last item collected.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 随机变为另一名角色，并移除最后获得的道具。

items.description: Damages all enemies and destroys all obstacles. The effect occurs every time a new room is entered for the rest of the floor. Opens the doors to the floor's Secret Rooms and Super Secret Rooms.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 伤害全房间敌人、破坏障碍物并打开隐藏房和超级隐藏房入口；本层之后进入的新房间也会触发。

items.description: Isaac farts, sending out a circular rock wave that destroys obstacles and hurts enemies.
items.quote: I can't believe it's not butter bean!
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 放屁并向周围发出环形岩石冲击波，伤害敌人、破坏障碍物。

items.description: Spawns a penny and has a 50% chance to double all items and pickups in the room. If the effect fails, the items and pickups disappear.
items.unlock: Defeat Delirium as  Keeper
items.descriptionZh: 有 50% 概率复制房间内全部道具和掉落物；失败时它们会消失，只留下硬币。
items.unlockZh: 使用店主击败精神错乱。

items.description: Hurts Isaac without depleting health, activating any items that trigger upon taking damage.
items.unlock: Defeat Delirium as  Eve
items.descriptionZh: 触发一次不扣生命的受伤效果，可激活需要受伤才能触发的道具。
items.unlockZh: 使用夏娃击败精神错乱。

items.description: Removes a Heart Container, increases damage and range, and grants a Cube of Meat.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 失去 1 个红心容器，获得伤害和射程提升，并获得一个肉块。

items.description: Grants a random item effect for the current room.
items.unlock: Defeat Ultra Greedier as  Eden
items.descriptionZh: 本房间内获得一种随机道具效果。
items.unlockZh: 使用伊甸击败究极贪婪第二阶段。

items.description: Grants a random die item that changes each use. Acts as any die item, and can by cycled by pressing the drop key.
items.unlock: Defeat Delirium as  Isaac
items.descriptionZh: 可以触发不同骰子道具的效果；按丢弃键切换当前骰子。
items.unlockZh: 使用以撒击败精神错乱。

items.description: Spawns two item pedestals then is consumed. Begins with no charges.
items.unlock: Defeat Delirium as  Eden
items.descriptionZh: 充满后生成两个道具底座，随后消失；初始没有充能。
items.unlockZh: 使用伊甸击败精神错乱。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that drops a random pill every 3 rooms. Upon using a pill, all enemies in the room are poisoned.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得每清理 3 个房间生成随机药丸的跟班；使用药丸时使房间内所有敌人中毒。

items.description: +1 luck. Spawns a fairy familiar that points out Secret Rooms, Crawl Space entrances, and tinted rocks.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 幸运 +1；获得提示隐藏房、夹层入口和标记石头的精灵跟班。

items.description: Increases damage based on how many empty Red Heart containers Isaac has.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 空红心容器越多，获得的伤害加成越高。

items.description: Tears fire sparks of electricity in random directions upon hitting an obstacle or enemy.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 泪弹命中敌人或障碍物时，向随机方向释放电弧。

items.description: Gives a chance to shoot fires alongside tears that block enemy shots and deal damage to enemies that touch them. Gives a chance to shoot blue fires alongside tears that become smaller as they travel.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 射击时有概率额外发射蓝色火焰，伤害敌人并抵消弹幕，火焰随飞行逐渐缩小。

items.description: Adds a luck-based chance to fire needles that instantly kill basic enemies and deal triple damage to bosses. If a needle kills an enemy, it bursts into more tears/needles.
items.unlock: Defeat Delirium as  Lilith
items.descriptionZh: 有概率发射针，瞬杀普通敌人，对首领造成 3 倍伤害；针击杀敌人后会分裂。触发概率受幸运影响。
items.unlockZh: 使用莉莉丝击败精神错乱。

items.description: Isaac becomes camouflaged at the beginning of each room. Until he shoots, all non-boss enemies will be confused. Isaac gains +0.5 Speed while camouflaged, and gains Tears and Damage upon breaking it.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 进入房间时进入伪装，使非首领敌人混乱，期间移速 +0.5；开始射击解除伪装，并获得短暂射速和伤害提升。

items.description: Whenever a Devil Room or Angel Room would spawn after defeating a boss, both rooms spawn. Only one can be entered.
items.unlock: Defeat Ultra Greedier as  Lilith
items.descriptionZh: 原本要出现恶魔房或天使房时，两种房间会同时出现，但只能进入其中一种。
items.unlockZh: 使用莉莉丝击败究极贪婪第二阶段。

items.description: An Angel Room will always spawn after every boss fight, excluding the first floor and floors after Chapter 4.
items.unlock: Defeat Delirium as  Magdalene
items.descriptionZh: 在符合条件的楼层，击败首领后必定出现天使房；第一层及子宫之后的楼层不适用。
items.unlockZh: 使用抹大拉击败精神错乱。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that drops a Grab Bag every 5-6 rooms cleared.
items.unlock: Defeat Ultra Greedier as  Cain
items.descriptionZh: 获得每清理 5–6 个房间掉落福袋的跟班。
items.unlockZh: 使用该隐击败究极贪婪第二阶段。

items.description: Grants a Red Heart container for every 25 Coins Isaac has.
items.unlock: Complete Pong (challenge #35)
items.descriptionZh: 每持有 25 枚硬币，获得 1 个红心容器。

items.description: Adds a chance to fire a creep shot that deals double damage and leaves a trail of slowing white creep.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 有概率发射双倍伤害的液体泪弹，沿途留下白色减速液体。

items.description: Adds a chance to fire a piercing tear that instantly kills any enemy that it touches. Adds a chance to fire a tear that summons Big Horn's hand to crush the first enemy it hits, instantly killing monsters or greatly damaging bosses.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 有概率发射召唤大魔角之手的泪弹，瞬杀首个命中的普通敌人，或对首领造成大量伤害。

items.description: Spawns a stationary fly turret that lasts for the current room and fires tears at nearby enemies.
items.unlock: Defeat Ultra Greed as  Apollyon
items.descriptionZh: 本房间内放置一个固定苍蝇炮台，自动向附近敌人射击。
items.unlockZh: 使用亚玻伦击败究极贪婪。

items.description: Upon entering a room with enemies in it, has a chance to spawn a random friendly enemy that persists across rooms.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 进入有敌人的房间时，有概率生成一个随机友方怪物，并可带到其他房间。

items.description: Isaac's tears deal double damage and inflict bleeding on enemies if they're facing away from Isaac.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 从背后命中敌人时造成双倍伤害，并使其流血。

items.description: Damages all enemies in the room. Has a chance to drop a Half Red Heart or Half Soul Heart if an enemy is hit. Damages all enemies in the room. Has a chance to drop a Half Red Heart if an enemy is hit.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 伤害房间内所有敌人；命中敌人时有概率生成半颗红心。

items.description: Spawns an orbiting razor that deals contact damage and inflicts bleeding on enemies, causing them to slowly take damage over time.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得绕身剃刀，造成接触伤害并使敌人流血，持续损失生命。

items.description: Spawns an orbital familiar that deals contact damage and fires a tear every 2 seconds. Spawns an orbital familiar that deals contact damage, blocks shots, and fires tears at enemies in its line of sight.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得绕身眼球，阻挡弹幕、造成接触伤害，并向视线内的敌人射击。

items.description: Spawns Delirium as a random friendly boss that fights for Isaac.
items.unlock: Defeat Delirium
items.descriptionZh: 召唤精神错乱，使其化为随机友方首领帮助战斗。

items.description: Spawns a fly familiar that orbits around a random enemy and deals 30 damage per second to enemies it comes in contact with.
items.unlock: Become Beelzebub
items.descriptionZh: 获得围绕随机敌人飞行的苍蝇跟班，伤害接触到的敌人。

items.description: Throws a black hole on the ground which sucks in and damages enemies and destroys nearby obstacles.
items.unlock: Defeat 20 Portals
items.descriptionZh: 投出一个黑洞，吸引并伤害敌人，同时破坏附近障碍物。
items.unlockZh: 累计消灭 20 个传送门敌人。

items.description: +0.1 flat damage, grants a Soul Heart. Enemies can randomly become briefly charmed or feared. Taking damage has a chance to spawn a Rainbow Poop.
items.unlock: Destroy 5 rainbow poops
items.descriptionZh: 伤害 +0.1，获得 1 颗魂心；随机使敌人短暂魅惑或恐惧，受伤时有概率生成彩虹大便。
items.unlockZh: 累计破坏 5 堆彩虹大便。

items.description: Enemies, enemy shots, tears, and pickups will briefly freeze in place at random intervals. The reward from clearing a room will sometimes be duplicated.
items.unlock: Complete 7 Daily Challenges (by touching the trophy at the end)
items.descriptionZh: 敌人、弹幕、泪弹和掉落物会随机短暂停顿；清房奖励有时会被复制。
items.unlockZh: 完成 7 次每日挑战，并触碰终点奖杯。

items.description: Spawns a random item from the current room's item pool, with a chance to spawn A Lump of Coal or The Poop instead.
items.unlock: Destroy 500 rocks
items.descriptionZh: 生成当前房间道具池中的一个随机道具，也有概率生成煤块或大便；使用后消失。

items.description: Creates a stationary sprinkler for the current room that rotates and fires tears in 8 directions. The tears copy Isaac's stats and most tear effects.
items.unlock: Beat Chapter 1 without taking damage
items.descriptionZh: 本房间内放置旋转洒水器，向 8 个方向发射继承角色属性和大多数特殊效果的泪弹。

items.description: +7 Bombs. Removes the delay between bomb placements, allowing them to be placed rapidly. Bombs will no longer knock each other away.
items.unlock: Defeat Little Horn 20 times
items.descriptionZh: 获得 7 枚炸弹；可以连续快速放置炸弹，炸弹之间不再相互炸飞。
items.unlockZh: 累计击败小魔角 20 次。

items.description: Spawns a familiar with a random tear effect. The familiar is randomized at the start of each floor.
items.unlock: Pick up 5 familiars in a single run
items.descriptionZh: 获得拥有随机泪弹效果的跟班，进入下一层时重新随机。
items.unlockZh: 在一局中获得 5 个跟班。

items.description: Grants a familiar that transforms into another random familiar every 10 seconds.
items.unlock: Defeat Delirium for the 1st time
items.descriptionZh: 获得每 10 秒变为另一种随机跟班的精神错乱宝宝。

items.description: Grants an active item charge every 15 enemies killed.
items.unlock: Pick up any 2 of the following items/trinkets in a single run: 9 Volt, The Battery, Car Battery, AAA Battery, and Watch Battery (  Any 2 items that have the 'battery' item tag)
items.descriptionZh: 每击杀 15 个敌人为主动道具增加 1 格充能。
items.unlockZh: 在一局中获得两个带有“电池”标签的道具或饰品，如 9 伏特、蓄电池、车载电池、AAA 电池或手表电池。

items.description: While held, guarantees one item in every Shop will be on sale. On use, makes a random item in the current room free.
items.unlock: Purchase anything from Shops, Devil Rooms, and/or Black Markets 50 times
items.descriptionZh: 持有时保证每个商店有一件打折商品；使用后使当前房间内一个随机收费物品免费。
items.unlockZh: 累计在商店、恶魔房或黑市购买物品 50 次。

items.description: Any enemy shots that come near Isaac for the next three seconds are held in place then fired back.
items.unlock: Beat Chapter 2 without taking damage
items.descriptionZh: 持续 3 秒将接近角色的敌方弹幕悬停，随后反射回去。

items.description: If the box is empty, picks up items and pickups in a room and stores them. If the box is not empty, places all stored items and pickups in the current room. Can carry up to 10 items or pickups at once.
items.unlock: Use Pandora's Box in Dark Room
items.descriptionZh: 空盒时收纳当前房间的道具和掉落物，非空时放出全部存货；最多携带 10 件。
items.unlockZh: 在暗室使用潘多拉魔盒。

items.description: Connects Isaac's tears with electricity that can damage enemies.
items.unlock: Pick up any 2 technology items in a single run (  Any 2 items that have the 'tech' item tag)
items.descriptionZh: 角色的泪弹之间会连起电弧，伤害接触到的敌人。
items.unlockZh: 在一局中获得两个带有“科技”标签的道具。

items.description: Taking damage grants a body part orbital that blocks shots and deals contact damage, up to a maximum of three. The body parts are destroyed after blocking enough damage.
items.unlock: Beat Chapter 3 without taking damage
items.descriptionZh: 受伤时获得一个可挡弹并造成接触伤害的绕身肢体，最多 3 个；挡下足够伤害后肢体会消失。

items.description: Spawns a random Harbinger familiar that changes every 10 seconds. Harbingers have different behaviors and spawn themed Locusts.
items.unlock: Defeat all 5 Harbingers
items.descriptionZh: 获得每 10 秒更换形态的天启骑士跟班；各形态有不同攻击方式，并生成对应的蝗虫。
items.unlockZh: 击败全部五位天启骑士。

items.description: Summons a controllable ghost that can perform various tasks depending on what it targets.
items.unlock: Open 20 Locked Chests
items.descriptionZh: 召唤可操控的幽灵，依照指定目标执行攻击、搬取物品等不同任务。
items.unlockZh: 累计打开 20 个金箱子。

items.description: Spawns an orbital familiar with a large orbital radius. Tears that pass through the prism split into four multi-colored tears.
items.unlock: Defeat an Angel 10 times
items.descriptionZh: 获得大范围绕身棱镜；穿过棱镜的泪弹分裂成 4 颗彩色泪弹。

items.description: Replaces Isaac's tears with eyeballs that can bounce off of each other. The eyeballs are not limited by range, and will instead dissipate when they stop moving or when hitting an enemy or obstacle.
items.unlock: Beat Chapter 4 without taking damage
items.descriptionZh: 泪弹变为会互相碰撞反弹的眼球，不受通常射程限制；停止移动或碰到敌人、障碍物时消失。

items.description: Grants a pickup or stat upgrade if all enemies in a room are killed in the order they are marked.
items.unlock: Take 25 Deals with the Devil
items.descriptionZh: 按标记顺序击杀房间内全部敌人，可获得掉落物或属性提升。
items.unlockZh: 累计进行 25 次恶魔交易。

items.description: Tears are now fired in an arc. Upon hitting the floor, an obstacle, or an enemy, they burst into many smaller tears in all directions. Increases tear delay.
items.unlock: Acquire Blood Clot 10 times
items.descriptionZh: 泪弹改为抛物线飞行，命中敌人、障碍物或地面后向四周爆出小泪弹；射击间隔增加。

items.description: Isaac's tears decelerate as they travel. Upon stopping or hitting an obstacle, they burst into 8 tears in all directions. Tears can be fired into other tears to feed them, increasing their damage.
items.unlock: Collect 10 "Tears Up" items or pills in one run
items.descriptionZh: 泪弹逐渐减速，停下或撞到障碍物后分裂为 8 颗；后续泪弹可以喂给前面的泪弹，提高其伤害。
items.unlockZh: 在一局中获得或使用 10 个提高射速的道具或药丸。

items.description: Tears are replaced with piercing white blasts of light that deal less damage but can damage the same enemy multiple times.
items.unlock: Take 25 Angel Rooms items
items.descriptionZh: 用白色穿透光束替代泪弹；单次伤害较低，但可对同一敌人造成多段伤害。
items.unlockZh: 累计获得 25 个天使房道具。

items.description: Allows Isaac to hold two active items.
items.unlock: Enter 6 Shops in one run
items.descriptionZh: 可以携带两个主动道具。
items.unlockZh: 在一局中进入 6 个商店。

items.description: Grants one Soul Heart. Upon entering a boss room, grants a shield that blocks one hit, then disappears.
items.unlock: Sleep in 10 beds
items.descriptionZh: 获得 1 颗魂心；进入首领房时获得一次性护盾，可抵消一次伤害。
items.unlockZh: 累计在床上睡觉 10 次。

items.description: Sacrifices up to 2 familiars and spawns an item for each familiar sacrificed. Converts all friendly spiders and flies into coins.
items.unlock: Take 50 Deals with the Devil
items.descriptionZh: 献祭最多两个跟班，每献祭一个生成一个道具；友方苍蝇和蜘蛛会被转换为硬币。
items.unlockZh: 累计进行 50 次恶魔交易。

items.description: Drops a random pill, and spawns a familiar that charges up and fires creep. Using pills changes the creep type.
items.unlock: Have Isaac die to his own explosion from Ipecac, Bob's Rotten Head, or a Horf! pill
items.descriptionZh: 生成一颗随机药丸，并获得可蓄力喷出液体的跟班；使用药丸会改变液体类型。
items.unlockZh: 被自己使用吐根酊、鲍勃的烂头或“呕！”药丸产生的爆炸炸死。

items.description: Spawns 3 random trinkets. Taking damage has a 5% chance to swallow Isaac's currently held trinket, gaining its effect permanently.
items.unlock: Use 5 Gulp! pills in one run (Placebo uses count)
items.descriptionZh: 生成 3 个随机饰品；受伤时有 5% 概率吞下当前饰品，永久保留其效果。
items.unlockZh: 在一局中使用 5 次“咕噜！”药丸，安慰剂触发也计入。

items.description: Spawns an egg familiar, which hatches a random friendly monster when Isaac is hurt once per room. The power of the monster improves for each consecutive room cleared without taking damage.
items.unlock: Spawn three charmed enemies in the same room
items.descriptionZh: 获得蛋跟班，每个房间受伤时可孵出一个友方怪物；连续无伤清房越多，孵出的怪物越强。
items.unlockZh: 在同一房间内生成三个被魅惑的敌人。

items.description: Tears bounce off the floor, creating splashes. Splashes deal 25% of Isaac's tear damage to all enemies in a small area.
items.unlock: Acquire Rubber Cement 5 times
items.descriptionZh: 泪弹会在地面弹跳并产生水花；水花对小范围敌人造成相当于泪弹伤害 25% 的伤害。
items.unlockZh: 累计获得橡胶胶水 5 次。

items.description: Grants one Bone Heart and spawns three Red Hearts.
items.unlock: Defeat Mom's Heart or It Lives! on Hard mode as  The Forgotten
items.descriptionZh: 获得 1 颗骨心，并生成 3 颗红心。
items.unlockZh: 使用遗骸击败妈妈的心脏或它还活着（困难模式）。

items.description: Spawns a bone familiar that circles around Isaac and reflects enemy shots.
items.unlock: Defeat Isaac as  The Forgotten
items.descriptionZh: 获得绕身骨头，可反射敌方弹幕。

items.description: Spawns a white poop familiar, which turns into a White Poop when Isaac is hurt. White poop has an aura that increases tear fire rate and can block enemy shots. The aura also increases damage by 20% and gives homing.
items.unlock: Defeat Hush as  The Forgotten
items.descriptionZh: 获得白色大便跟班，受伤时在地面留下圣地大便；其光环提高射速、伤害并赋予追踪效果，也可阻挡弹幕。

items.description: Spawns a bone familiar that hovers back and forth in front of Isaac, dealing damage equal to Isaac's damage.
items.unlock: Defeat Satan as  The Forgotten
items.descriptionZh: 获得在角色前方来回伸缩的骨头跟班，接触伤害随角色伤害变化。

items.description: Creates a friendly Bony, Black Bony, or an orbital bone for each enemy killed in the current room. Creates a friendly Bony, Black Bony, Bone Fly, Revenant, or an orbital bone for each enemy killed in the current room.
items.unlock: Defeat Delirium as  The Forgotten
items.descriptionZh: 根据本房间已经击杀的敌人数量，生成友方骨系怪物或绕身骨头。
items.unlockZh: 使用遗骸击败精神错乱。

items.description: Creates a ring of light around Isaac that petrifies enemies in contact.
items.unlock: Defeat Ultra Greedier as  The Forgotten
items.descriptionZh: 获得环绕角色的光环，使接触它的敌人石化。
items.unlockZh: 使用遗骸击败究极贪婪第二阶段。

items.description: Grants one Bone Heart, +0.7 tears, spawns a Mysterious Paper.
items.unlock: Complete the Boss Rush as  The Forgotten
items.descriptionZh: 获得 1 颗骨心，射速 +0.7，并生成神秘纸片饰品。
items.unlockZh: 使用遗骸完成首领车轮战。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that flies through the room while firing, dealing a flat 7 contact damage to enemies and retrieving pickups.
items.unlock: Defeat ??? as  The Forgotten
items.descriptionZh: 获得射击时向前飞出的颌骨跟班，伤害敌人并取回掉落物。

items.description: Replaces all Red Heart Containers with 6 empty Bone Hearts. Upon losing a Bone Heart, Isaac fires bones in 8 directions and permanently gains a tears up. Upon losing a Bone Heart, Isaac fires bones in 8 directions and permanently gains a fire rate up.
items.unlock: Defeat The Lamb as  The Forgotten
items.descriptionZh: 将红心容器替换为 6 颗空骨心；失去骨心时向 8 个方向发射骨头，并永久提高射速。

items.description: While held, causes Mom to continuously attempt to stomp on Isaac. Activating makes her stop for the current room or wave. One of two parts necessary to create Mom's Shovel.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 持有时妈妈会不断踩踏角色；使用可让她在本房间或本波次暂停。与另一片铲子碎片组合为妈妈的铲子。

items.description: One of two parts necessary to create Mom's Shovel. No effect if somehow obtained on its own.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 用于与另一片铲子碎片合成妈妈的铲子；单独获得时没有独立效果。

items.description: Creates a trapdoor that leads to the next floor. Unlocks The Forgotten when used on a mound of dirt that appears in Dark Room.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 挖出通往下一层的活板门；在暗室的特定土堆上使用，可以解锁遗骸。

items.description: Gives Isaac the chance to fire spore tears that stick to enemies and blow up after a few seconds, dealing damage and poisoning nearby enemies and releasing more spores.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 有概率发射黏附敌人的孢子，数秒后爆开，伤害并毒伤附近敌人，同时散播更多孢子。

items.description: Enemies near Isaac are afflicted with fear.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 使附近敌人恐惧。

items.description: Spends five Pennies to increase Isaac's damage by 1.2 for the current room.
items.unlock: In a single run, obtain 99 Coins, then spend all of them
items.descriptionZh: 消耗 5 枚硬币，本房间内伤害 +1.2。
items.unlockZh: 在一局中获得 99 枚硬币，随后将其全部花完。

items.description: Grants Brimstone for the current room.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 本房间内获得硫磺火效果。

items.description: Gives Isaac a fortune, Soul Heart, Card, Rune, or trinket, similar to a Fortune Telling Machine. Fortunes are much more likely to be given than anything else.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 类似占卜机，随机给出预言、魂心、卡牌、符文或饰品；得到预言的概率更高。

items.description: Causes Isaac to occasionally fire extra tears in random directions while shooting.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 射击时偶尔向随机方向额外发射泪弹。

items.description: Repeatedly zaps enemies that are close to Isaac.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 反复电击靠近角色的敌人。

items.description: Releases a ring of tears and increases fire rate for the current room when Isaac takes damage.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 受伤时释放一圈泪弹，并提高本房间内的射速。

items.description: Quadruples fire rate, with ×0.3 damage multiplier. Each tear is given a random effect that alters its movement.
items.quote: DMG down + tears up + you feel nutty
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 射速变为 4 倍，伤害倍率 ×0.3；每颗泪弹附带随机的移动轨迹效果。

items.description: Locks Isaac's attributes to their highest values reached.
items.unlock: Complete Boss Rush as  Jacob and Esau
items.descriptionZh: 将各项属性锁定在曾达到的最高值，阻止面板数值下降；后续提升仍会受到实际属性计算的影响。
items.unlockZh: 使用雅各和以扫完成首领车轮战。

items.description: +5 Bombs. Each bomb gains 1-4 random bomb synergies.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得 5 枚炸弹；每枚炸弹随机获得 1–4 种炸弹强化效果。

items.description: +0.5 Tears, +0.2 Shot Speed.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)

items.description: Spawns a familiar that chases enemies. After killing enough enemies, it becomes more powerful but will also try to hurt Isaac, it will also generate Half Red Hearts on enemy kills. It can increase in power one more stage after killing even more enemies. Dealing enough damage to it returns it to normal.
items.unlock: Defeat Mother as  Lilith
items.descriptionZh: 获得追击敌人的宠物；击杀足够敌人后逐级变强，也会试图伤害角色，并在击杀时生成半红心。对它造成足够伤害可使其恢复正常。

items.description: During the transition between floors, Isaac's nightmare shows the contents of the upcoming floor's Treasure Room, as well as the floor's boss. Grants a Half Soul Heart when entering a new floor.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 进入下一层的梦境中预览宝物房道具和首领；到达新楼层时获得半颗魂心。

items.description: Gives Isaac a familiar that grants +0.4 Fire Rate for each consecutive room he's cleared without taking damage. The bonus stacks up to five times.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得蜡烛跟班；每连续无伤清理一个房间，射速 +0.4，最多叠加 5 次。

items.description: Double tapping a fire key creates a shield that pushes away enemies and reflects enemy projectiles and lasers.
items.unlock: Defeat Hush as  Bethany
items.descriptionZh: 双击射击方向生成护盾，可推开敌人，并反射弹幕和激光。

items.description: Stabs Isaac at the beginning of each floor, draining his Red Hearts. Increases damage and speed for the floor based on the amount drained.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 每层开始时抽取角色红心；根据消耗的红心数量，提高本层伤害与移速。

items.description: Grants multicolored tears. Each color comes with a different status or tear effect.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得多种颜色的泪弹，每种颜色对应不同的异常状态或特殊效果。

items.description: Prevents creep and floor spikes from damaging Isaac. Also gives Isaac +0.3 speed and 2 Soul Hearts.
items.quote: Speed up + your feet feel stronger
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得 2 颗魂心，移速 +0.3，并免疫地面液体和地刺伤害。

items.description: +1 damage, +2 range, -0.16 shot speed. Isaac's tears can be controlled mid-flight with tear controls.
items.quote: DMG up + range up + controlled tears
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 伤害 +1、射程 +2、弹速 -0.16；泪弹飞行中可通过射击方向转向。

items.description: Adds one Red Heart Container and fully restores health. x1.2 damage multiplier. Isaac will occasionally fire extra tears that orbit around him.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 增加 1 个红心容器并恢复生命，伤害倍率 ×1.2；射击时偶尔额外发射绕身泪弹。

items.description: Isaac gains an aura that deals damage to enemies inside it.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得持续伤害范围内敌人的光环。

items.description: A familiar burrows in Isaac's head, firing 4 slowing tears. Upon taking damage, there's a chance it will burst out of Isaac's head, spawning blue spiders and chasing enemies for the current room.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 头上寄生一只会发射 4 颗减速泪弹的蜘蛛；受伤时有概率脱离，本房间内追击敌人并生成蓝蜘蛛。

items.description: Destroying poop spawns Dip Familiars that follow Isaac and damage enemies. Destroying different types of poop spawns different Dips with special effects.
items.unlock: Complete Scat Man (challenge #36)
items.descriptionZh: 破坏大便后生成友方小便便，跟随角色并伤害敌人；不同类型的大便会产生不同特殊效果的小便便。

items.description: Spawns a sword above Isaac's head, which doubles all item pedestals. After Isaac takes damage, the sword can randomly fall at any point, instantly killing him.
items.quote: A king's fortune... but at what cost?
items.unlock: Defeat The Lamb as  Jacob and Esau
items.descriptionZh: 头顶悬挂利剑，增加可获得的道具底座；受伤后利剑随时可能落下，立即杀死角色。
items.unlockZh: 使用雅各和以扫击败羔羊。

items.description: Creates a large pool of yellow creep beneath Isaac.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 在脚下生成一大片伤害敌人的黄色液体。

items.description: Instead of tears, Isaac swings a sword. Charging does a spin attack and fires a projectile, and a projectile is sometimes fired with normal swings if Isaac has no empty Red Heart Containers.
items.unlock: Complete Isaac's Awakening (challenge #39)
items.descriptionZh: 用剑挥砍替代泪弹；蓄力可进行旋转攻击并发射剑气，红心填满时普通挥砍也可能发射剑气。

items.description: Creates a Red Room adjacent to a viable wall, indicated by the outline of a door. These rooms have a 10% chance to be a special room.
items.unlock: Open Mom's Chest in  Home
items.descriptionZh: 在标有门轮廓的有效墙壁处创建相邻红房间；红房间有 10% 概率为特殊房间。
items.unlockZh: 在家中打开妈妈的箱子。

items.description: Spawns a fly orbital familiar that seeks out incoming enemy shots and destroys them.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得灵能苍蝇，会主动拦截并摧毁接近角色的敌方弹幕。

items.description: Increases fire rate, decreases speed, and distorts the screen. All effects become more pronounced with repeated use, and wear off by clearing rooms.
items.quote: Tears up. A mind changing experience!
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 提高射速、降低移速并扭曲画面；连续使用会加深效果，清理房间可逐渐解除。

items.description: +5 Bombs. If Isaac is currently firing, placing a bomb will instead shoot a fast-moving, explosive rocket in the direction he's facing.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得 5 枚炸弹；射击时放炸弹会改为向面向方向发射高速爆炸火箭。

items.description: Spawns a destroyable orbiting wisp familiar that fires tears and deals contact damage. Also acts as a passive item that causes other active items to spawn themed wisps.
items.unlock: Defeat Isaac as  Bethany
items.descriptionZh: 生成可被摧毁的绕身灵火，能够射击并造成接触伤害；与其他主动道具配合时，会生成对应主题的灵火。

items.description: Spawns three Soul Hearts and two Angel Room items and is consumed. Starts with no charges, and can only be charged by picking up 6 Soul Hearts.
items.unlock: Defeat The Lamb as  Bethany
items.descriptionZh: 需拾取 6 颗魂心充能；充满后使用，生成 3 颗魂心和两个天使房道具，随后消失。

items.description: Generates a ladder at the start of every floor that leads to a unique Angel Room shop.
items.quote: May you get what you came for
items.unlock: Defeat Isaac as  Jacob and Esau
items.descriptionZh: 每层起始房间出现一架梯子，通往出售物品的特殊天使房。
items.unlockZh: 使用雅各和以扫击败以撒。

items.description: Reveals the location of the Boss Room. Upon defeating a boss, activates XIX - The Sun, fully recharges Isaac's active item, grants bonus damage and luck for the rest of the floor, and removes curses.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 显示首领房位置；击败首领后触发太阳卡效果、充满主动道具、移除诅咒，并提高本层伤害和幸运。

items.description: Adds an extra Secret Room and Super Secret Room to each floor. Secret Rooms contain a beam of light that increases Fire Rate for the current floor and gives a Half Soul Heart.
items.quote: The moon's blessing shines upon you
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 每层额外生成一个隐藏房和超级隐藏房；隐藏房内出现月光，照射后提高本层射速并给予半颗魂心。

items.description: +0.4 speed. Doors stay open after entering a room, even in rooms with enemies.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 移速 +0.4；进入有敌人的普通房间后，门仍保持开启。

items.description: Adds one red Heart container. Heals 1 additional Red Heart. Enemies near Isaac become charmed.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 增加 1 个红心容器，额外恢复 1 颗红心；魅惑附近敌人。

items.description: +1 Damage. Replaces tears with rocks that deal variable damage, have increased knockback, and can destroy obstacles.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 伤害 +1；泪弹变为伤害浮动的石块，击退力增强，并可破坏障碍物。

items.description: Dash by double-tapping the movement key, becoming invulnerable and damaging enemies. There's a short cooldown before Isaac can dash again.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 双击移动方向进行冲刺，期间无敌并伤害敌人；每次冲刺后有短暂冷却。

items.description: +2 red Heart containers, -0.3 speed. Isaac builds speed while standing still, and releases poison gas clouds when he moves afterwards.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 增加 2 个红心容器，移速 -0.3；静止时积蓄速度，随后移动会放出毒气。

items.description: Upon entering a room, a circle of tears orbits Isaac. Enemy tears have a chance to be caught in orbit, turning them friendly.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 进入房间时获得一圈绕身泪弹；敌方弹幕有概率被捕获，变成友方绕身泪弹。

items.description: Isaac shoots ice tears, which slow enemies and freeze monsters they kill. Frozen enemies slide away and explode into ice shards when touched.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 泪弹附带冰冻效果，使敌人减速，并冻结被击杀的怪物；推动冻结尸体可使其滑行、碎裂为冰片。

items.description: Isaac's mouth fills with tears over time while not firing, up to a cap. Holding the fire button will release all stored tears in rapid succession.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 停止射击时在口中储存泪弹；按住射击键后快速释放储存的泪弹。

items.description: +0.7 tears. Significantly shrinks Isaac, allowing him to squeeze between objects and makes some enemy shots pass over him.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 射速 +0.7；体型大幅缩小，可穿过部分狭窄间隙，并躲过部分弹幕。

items.description: Spawns an additional Curse Room on each floor. Curse Rooms have improved layouts.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 每层额外生成一个诅咒房，并改善诅咒房布局。

items.description: Increases the fire rate in Isaac's left eye, causing his eyes to fire at different rates.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 左眼射速提高，使双眼以不同频率交替射击。

items.description: +0.7 tears, grants an Eternal Heart. Allows Angel Rooms to appear even if a Devil Deal has been taken before. Reduces the Devil/Angel room chance penalty for taking Red heart damage.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 射速 +0.7，获得 1 颗永恒之心；进行过恶魔交易后仍可出现天使房，并减轻红心受伤对恶魔房、天使房概率的惩罚。

items.description: Adds a trapdoor to every Shop that leads to a second shop with a unique stock and marked-up prices.
items.unlock: Spend 40+ coins in a single Shop
items.descriptionZh: 商店出现通往地下会员商店的活板门，出售特殊库存，价格较高。
items.unlockZh: 在一个商店中花费至少 40 枚硬币。

items.description: Recharges Isaac's currently held active item and drops 2-4 batteries.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 为当前主动道具充能，并生成 2–4 个电池。

items.description: Lets Isaac pick up and throw rocks, TNT, Poops, friendly Dips, Bombs, and other obstacles.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 可以举起并投掷石头、TNT、大便、友方小便便、炸弹和其他障碍物。

items.description: Summons The Peeper for the current room, which leaves a trail of red creep.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 本房间内召唤窥眼跟班，它移动时会留下伤害性血迹。

items.description: Adds a chance to fire tears that create rifts where they land, which suck enemies, pickups, and shots towards them and damage enemies in the area.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 泪弹有概率在落点生成裂隙，吸引附近敌人、掉落物和弹幕，并伤害范围内敌人。

items.description: Gives Isaac a familiar that fires chaotic bursts of tears in all directions.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得向四周混乱喷射泪弹的跟班。

items.description: Spawns a shooting familiar that has a chance to petrify enemies, and freezes monsters upon killing them.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得射击跟班，有概率石化敌人，并冻结其击杀的怪物。

items.description: Rerolls all items in the room. Each item has a 25% chance to disappear instead.
items.unlock: Defeat Mother as  ???
items.descriptionZh: 重置当前房间内的全部道具底座；每个道具有 25% 概率直接消失。

items.description: The first time Isaac takes damage in a room, a familiar leaps on an enemy, dealing damage and releasing a rock wave. For the rest of the room, it chases enemies similar to Dead Bird.
items.unlock: Defeat Mother as  Eve
items.descriptionZh: 每个房间首次受伤时，鸟跟班砸向敌人并释放岩石冲击波，之后持续追击敌人。

items.description: Isaac shouts, damaging and pushing away nearby enemies. The shout gets stronger the more charges the item has. Larynx gains 1 charge whenever Isaac takes damage, in addition to charging normally.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Tainted Samson
items.descriptionZh: 大声喊叫，伤害并击退附近敌人；消耗的充能越多，威力越大。除正常充能外，受伤也增加 1 格充能。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化参孙击败祸兽。

items.description: Creates a ghostly familiar that closely follows behind Isaac. It dies in one hit, but respawns at the start of the next floor. Each time it survives until the next floor, it rewards Isaac with Soul Hearts, Eternal Hearts, or an Item.
items.unlock: Defeat Mother as  The Lost
items.descriptionZh: 获得一击即死的幽灵跟班，死亡后于下一层重生；若成功存活到下一层，会奖励魂心、永恒之心或道具。

items.description: Grants a Red Heart container and restores 5 hearts. Bombs leave behind damaging red creep. Isaac can place Bombs at the cost of half a heart if he doesn't have any.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 增加 1 个红心容器并恢复 5 颗红心；炸弹留下伤害性血迹，没有炸弹时可消耗半颗心放置炸弹。

items.description: Spawns a Dumpy familiar that pushes away nearby enemies and projectiles just before Isaac is about to be hit, then falls asleep. He can be awoken by walking to him.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 即将受击时，跟班会吹开附近敌人和弹幕，随后睡着；靠近它可将其唤醒。

items.description: Gives a chance to shoot fires alongside tears that block enemy shots and deal damage to enemies that touch them.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 射击时有概率额外发射火焰，可阻挡弹幕并伤害接触到的敌人。

items.description: Gives Isaac the chance to fire tears that magnetize enemies they hit, causing them to attract nearby pickups and enemies, as well as tears/shots from all sources.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 有概率发射磁性泪弹；命中的敌人会吸引附近敌人、掉落物以及双方的弹幕。

items.description: Adds a chance to fire tears that mark enemies with the Bait status effect. Enemies marked as bait are attacked by other enemies.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 有概率将敌人标记为诱饵，使其他敌人攻击它。

items.description: Grants a character-specific effect that enhances their special abilities.
items.unlock: Defeat ??? as  Jacob and Esau
items.descriptionZh: 根据当前角色提供专属强化，增强该角色的特殊能力。

items.description: Refills all heart containers. Grants an enormous damage boost that wears off over time.
items.unlock: Defeat Satan as  Jacob and Esau
items.descriptionZh: 填满红心容器，并获得随时间逐渐衰减的大量伤害加成。
items.unlockZh: 使用雅各和以扫击败撒但。

items.description: Removes all of Isaac's items and pickups and takes him to a unique Bedroom with some pickups and Chests and a trapdoor to the next floor. For every item Isaac lost, he gets to take an item from a set of three.
items.unlock: Defeat Ultra Greedier as  Jacob and Esau
items.descriptionZh: 移除现有道具和资源，前往特殊卧室；每失去一个道具，就可从三个选项中重新选择一个，房内还提供补给和出口。
items.unlockZh: 使用雅各和以扫击败究极贪婪第二阶段。

items.description: Adds 5 Keys on pickup. Allows Isaac to throw his keys to deal damage to enemies, destroy obstacles, and open doors.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得 5 把钥匙；使用时投掷钥匙，伤害敌人、破坏障碍物并打开门。

items.description: Drops 5 random cards.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 生成 5 张随机卡牌。

items.description: Gigantifies Isaac for 30 seconds, increasing damage and range while lowering tears, granting invulnerability, and allowing Isaac to crush enemies and obstacles he walks on. The effect persists between rooms.
items.unlock: Earn all Hard mode Completion Marks for all non-Tainted characters
items.descriptionZh: 巨大化 30 秒，提高伤害和射程、降低射速，获得无敌并可碾碎敌人和障碍物；效果可跨房间持续。
items.unlockZh: 使用所有非堕化角色取得全部困难模式通关标记。

items.description: Combined with Knife Piece 2, creates a knife familiar that damages enemies and can open the door to the Corpse.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 与菜刀碎片 2 合成菜刀跟班，可伤害敌人，并打开通往尸宫的门。

items.description: Combined with Knife Piece 1, creates a knife familiar that damages enemies and can open the door to the Corpse.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 与菜刀碎片 1 合成菜刀跟班，可伤害敌人，并打开通往尸宫的门。

items.description: Takes Isaac to an abandoned and expanded version of Home, which has one copy of every item in the game. After taking an item, Isaac returns to the room he used Death Certificate in.
items.unlock: Earn all Hard mode Completion Marks for all characters, including tainted ones
items.descriptionZh: 传送到陈列大量道具的废弃家园，选择一个道具后返回使用死亡证明的房间。
items.unlockZh: 使用所有角色，包括堕化角色，取得全部困难模式通关标记。

items.description: Spawns an orbiting fly familiar that fires shielded tears at incoming enemy projectiles.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得绕身机器苍蝇，向接近的敌方弹幕发射可挡弹的泪弹。

items.description: Splits all enemies in the room into two smaller versions of themselves with much less health.
items.unlock: Defeat Mother as  Isaac
items.descriptionZh: 将房间内敌人分裂为两个更小、生命值更低的个体。

items.description: +2 luck. Provides immunity to burn, confusion, fear, and poison.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 幸运 +2，免疫灼烧、混乱、恐惧和中毒。

items.description: Grants flight, +2 damage, and increases speed to 1.1. Grants enough health to have 6 full hearts, if possible. Grants the Holy Mantle effect for the room it was obtained in. Automatically given to Isaac after defeating Dogma.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 击败教条后自动获得；给予飞行、伤害 +2、移速至少 1.1，并尽可能补足至 6 颗心。本房间内还获得神圣屏障。

items.description: While in a room with enemies, spawns red cracks in the ground. Walking over these cracks summons ghosts that launch themselves at enemies and explode.
items.unlock: Complete Baptism by Fire (challenge #38)
items.descriptionZh: 战斗房间的地面出现红色裂缝；踩过后召唤幽灵，冲向敌人并爆炸。

items.description: Passively spawns a familiar that moves in the direction Isaac shoots. On use, Isaac swaps places with the familiar.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得随射击方向移动的跟班；使用后与跟班交换位置。

items.description: Brings Isaac back to the first floor of a new run, retaining all of his items.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 返回新一局的第一层，同时保留已持有的道具。

items.description: Adds a chance to shoot a fist tear that has extremely high knockback and confuses enemies.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 有概率发射拳头泪弹，强力击退并混乱敌人。

items.description: Throws an eraser that instantly kills the first monster it hits, and prevents that monster from spawning for the rest of the run. Deals 15 damage to bosses, erasing that boss if fatal. Can only be used once per floor.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 每层可投掷一次橡皮擦：擦除首个命中的普通怪物，使该怪物本局不再生成；对首领造成 15 点伤害，若击杀则也会擦除。

items.description: Gives Isaac a Rotten Heart.
items.unlock: Defeat Mother as  Magdalene
items.descriptionZh: 获得 1 颗腐心。

items.description: Spews a stream of damaging flame. Gains Soul Charges each time an enemy dies, which are used to fuel the urn.
items.unlock: Defeat Satan as  Bethany
items.descriptionZh: 喷射伤害敌人的火焰；敌人死亡时获得灵魂充能，用作喷火燃料。

items.description: While in an uncleared room, Isaac forms a trail of bloody tears that drags behind him, bursting and dealing damage upon contact with enemies.
items.unlock: Defeat Mother as  Judas
items.descriptionZh: 在未清理房间内拖出一串血泪，血泪接触敌人时爆开并造成伤害。

items.description: Consumes one heart container or two Soul Hearts to spawn an item and give Isaac a broken heart container that can never be filled. If Magic Skin isn't being held after being used, it is very likely to replace any future items.
items.unlock: Defeat Mother as  Jacob and Esau
items.descriptionZh: 消耗 1 个红心容器或 2 颗魂心，生成一个道具并增加 1 颗碎心。使用后若不再持有玄奇驴皮，后续道具很可能被替换为它。
items.unlockZh: 使用雅各和以扫击败母亲。

items.description: Grants flight and two Soul Hearts. In addition to tears, Isaac can charge up and fire a powerful holy laser.
items.unlock: Defeat Mother as  Bethany
items.descriptionZh: 获得飞行和 2 颗魂心；正常射击之外，还可蓄力发射强力圣光激光。

items.description: Increases Isaac's lowest stat and drops either 3 Coins, 1 Bomb, or 1 Key depending on what Isaac has the least of.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 提高当前最低的一项属性，并按最缺少的资源生成 3 枚硬币、1 枚炸弹或 1 把钥匙。

items.description: Gives Isaac a Teratoma orbital that blocks shots, deals contact damage, and splits into smaller versions of itself upon taking damage. The smaller versions break into blue spiders.
items.unlock: Defeat Mother as  Lazarus
items.descriptionZh: 获得可挡弹并造成接触伤害的绕身畸胎瘤；受击后分裂成更小的个体，最终化为蓝蜘蛛。

items.description: +5 Bombs. Bombs fire four Brimstone lasers in the cardinal directions upon exploding.
items.unlock: After breaking Hornfel's minecart, kill him before he can escape
items.descriptionZh: 获得 5 枚炸弹；炸弹爆炸时向上下左右发射硫磺火激光。
items.unlockZh: 破坏角岩的矿车，并在它逃走前将其击杀。

items.description: Active items don't charge when clearing rooms. Instead, they're charged by dealing damage to enemies.
items.quote: Beat the juice out of them!
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 主动道具不再通过清理房间充能，改为通过对敌人造成伤害来充能。

items.description: Gives Isaac a miniature Baby Plum familiar that propels itself diagonally around the room, firing tears behind itself as it travels.
items.unlock: Defeat Baby Plum 10 times
items.descriptionZh: 获得小型糖梅宝宝跟班，在房间中沿对角线移动，并向身后发射眼泪。

items.description: Summons the boss Baby Plum to fight for Isaac in the current room.
items.unlock: Allow Baby Plum to escape instead of defeating her
items.descriptionZh: 本房间内召唤糖梅宝宝协助战斗。
items.unlockZh: 让糖梅宝宝自行离开，而不是击败它。

items.description: Spawns a star familiar that slowly travels towards the Boss Room, giving an aura that increases damage and tears and grants homing tears.
items.unlock: Defeat Delirium as  Bethany
items.descriptionZh: 获得缓慢向首领房移动的星星跟班；其光环提高伤害与射速，并赋予追踪泪弹。
items.unlockZh: 使用伯大尼击败精神错乱。

items.description: Spawns an ice cube familiar that slides around when walked into. It slows and deals contact damage, freezing monsters it kills.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得可用身体推动的冰块跟班，滑行时减速并伤害敌人，冻结其击杀的怪物。

items.description: While held, enemies leave behind ghosts on death. Stronger enemies leave bigger ghosts. Using the item causes the ghosts to explode and damage nearby enemies, and instantly kills all ghost enemies with less than 50% HP.
items.unlock: Defeat Ultra Greedier as  Bethany
items.descriptionZh: 持有时，被击杀敌人留下大小不一的幽灵；使用后引爆幽灵伤害附近敌人，并立即击杀生命低于一半的幽灵类敌人。
items.unlockZh: 使用伯大尼击败究极贪婪第二阶段。

items.description: Converts good pills into bad pills and identifies all pills. Bad pills now have secondary positive effects. Grants one Black Heart.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得 1 颗黑心并鉴定所有药丸；正面药丸变为负面药丸，但负面药丸附带额外的正面效果。

items.description: Gives +0.5 speed and greatly increases the rotation speed and damage of orbitals for 3 seconds. Passively gives Isaac a spinning top orbital that blocks enemy shots and deals contact damage.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 使用后短暂提高移速，以及环绕物的旋转速度和伤害；持有时获得可挡弹并造成接触伤害的陀螺环绕物。
游戏内部隐藏条目，与可使用的达摩克里斯之剑不是同一编号；现有数据未提供独立效果说明。
items.unlockZh: 现有数据未提供解锁条件。

items.description: Enemies explode into tears upon death, which inherit the effects of Isaac's tears.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 敌人死亡时爆出眼泪，这些眼泪继承角色的眼泪效果。

items.description: Causes Isaac to spawn Minisaac familiars when he takes damage, which chase and shoot at nearby enemies.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 受伤时生成迷你以撒跟班，追击并射击附近敌人。

items.description: +2.5 Range, Increases tear size.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 射程 +2.5，泪弹体积增大。

items.description: Spawns two portals at the beginning of each floor that each lead to either the Boss Room, Treasure Room, Secret Room, or the Shop.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 每层起始房间出现两个传送门，分别通往首领房、宝物房、隐藏房或商店中的不同目的地。

items.description: The first five enemies killed in a room will spawn stationary shooting familiars where they died.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 每个房间最先击杀的 5 个敌人，会在死亡位置留下固定射击的跟班。

items.description: Isaac periodically turns into a spiked statue, briefly becoming invulnerable and dealing contact damage.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 角色周期性变成带刺石像，短暂无敌并造成接触伤害。

items.description: +1 Red Heart Container and fully heals Isaac. Item pedestals also offer a random food item. Picking up a food item temporarily grants +3.6 damage and permanently boosts 2 stats.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 增加 1 个红心容器并回满红心；道具底座额外提供一种食物选择。拾取食物后暂时伤害 +3.6，并永久提高两项属性。

items.description: Shows the contents of Chests, Fire Places, Grab Bags, and Shopkeepers before they're opened/destroyed.
items.unlock: Defeat Mother as  Cain
items.descriptionZh: 提前显示箱子、火堆、福袋和店主被打开或破坏后会掉落什么。

items.description: Spawns a controllable Keeper to fight enemies alongside Isaac, functioning similarly to Jacob and Esau. If Keeper dies, he spawns 5 blue spiders and Strawman is removed from Isaac's inventory.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Tainted Keeper
items.descriptionZh: 获得可操控的店主，与角色协同移动和攻击；店主死亡后生成 5 只蓝蜘蛛，并失去稻草人。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化店主击败祸兽。

items.description: Sends Isaac on an Ascent toward Home.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 触发通往家的回溯流程。

items.description: Adds a Red Heart Container, fully heals Isaac, and gives +0.2 Speed, +0.5 Damage, +0.5 Tears, +2.5 Range, +0.2 Shot Speed, and +1.0 Luck. Increases the chance of encountering a Devil Room, Angel Room, and/or Planetarium each by 6.9%.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 增加一个红心容器并恢复生命，提高多项属性，以及恶魔房、天使房和星象房的出现几率。

items.description: If a room gives a reward when cleared, there will be two different rewards to chose from. Taking one causes the other to disappear.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Isaac
items.descriptionZh: 清房有奖励时会提供两种奖励，只能选择其中一种。

items.description: Gives Isaac a permanent stat boost whenever he heals with Red Heart pickups.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Magdalene
items.descriptionZh: 通过拾取红心恢复生命时，永久提高一项属性。

items.description: Devil deals now cost Coins, Shop items now cost health, and consumables in shops are free but surrounded by spikes.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Cain
items.descriptionZh: 恶魔交易改为花费硬币，商店道具改为花费生命；商店消耗品免费，但周围有地刺。

items.description: If Isaac enters a Devil Room but leaves without taking/opening anything in it, he gets +1 Damage and a Soul Heart at the start of the next floor.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Judas
items.descriptionZh: 进入恶魔房后，若不拿取或打开其中任何物品便离开，下一层开始时获得伤害 +1 和 1 颗魂心。

items.description: On death, Isaac's ghost is chained to his dead body and he can continue to fight with 1/2 of a heart, returning to life after 10 seconds. After it activates, it must be recharged by picking up a Soul Heart.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  The Forgotten
items.descriptionZh: 致死伤害后，灵魂以半颗心连在尸体上继续战斗；坚持 10 秒即可复活。触发后需拾取魂心重新激活。

items.description: Unlocks doors and reveals a random room on the map when Isaac takes damage.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Eve
items.descriptionZh: 受伤时打开可解锁的门，并在地图上揭示一个随机房间。

items.description: If Isaac has one red heart or fewer at the beginning of a floor, he gains an empty red heart container.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Samson
items.descriptionZh: 每层开始时，若红心不多于 1 颗，则获得 1 个空红心容器。

items.description: Causes Isaac to turn into a ghost if he gets hit while in an uncleared room, giving him flight and spectral tears and blocking the next hit he takes.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Lazarus
items.descriptionZh: 在未清理房间受伤后变成幽灵，获得飞行、幽灵泪弹，并抵消下一次伤害。

items.description: Replaces tears with fetuses that chase down enemies and deal contact damage. Each shot requires a brief charge up.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Lilith
items.descriptionZh: 用短暂蓄力后发射的胎儿替代泪弹；胎儿会追击敌人并造成接触伤害。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that charges a miniature Maw Of The Void attack while Isaac shoots.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Azazel
items.descriptionZh: 获得随射击蓄力、释放小型虚空之喉黑环的跟班。
items.unlockZh: 使用阿撒泻勒击败祸兽。

items.description: While firing, Isaac charges up a short-ranged Brimstone-like diarrhea beam that shoots behind him.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  ???
items.descriptionZh: 持续射击时蓄力，向身后喷出类似硫磺火的短程腹泻光束。

items.description: A familiar that flies forward, consuming pickups in its path. Each one will increase its size and damage and spawn a Blue Fly. Every four pickups, it opens a portal that leads to an unexplored room.
items.unlock: Defeat Mother as  Apollyon
items.descriptionZh: 获得向前飞行并吞噬掉落物的跟班；每吞一件会增大、增强伤害并生成蓝苍蝇，每吞四件创建通往未探索房间的传送门。

items.description: Gives Isaac a Nerve Ending familiar that burrows out of the ground to grab and deal damage to enemies over time.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Apollyon
items.descriptionZh: 获得从地下伸出的触手跟班，抓住敌人并持续伤害它们。

items.description: Enemies spawn floating bones on death, which block shots and damage/repel enemies that touch them.
items.unlock: Defeat Mother as  The Forgotten
items.descriptionZh: 敌人死亡时留下悬浮骨刺，阻挡弹幕并伤害、弹开接触的敌人。

items.description: Enemies have a chance to spawn ghosts on death, which chase and deal contact damage to enemies and explode after a short time.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  The Lost
items.descriptionZh: 敌人死亡时有概率生成友方幽灵，追击敌人造成接触伤害，并在短时间后爆炸。

items.description: Spawns random wisps that shoot various tears, block shots, and deal contact damage. The number of wisps spawned increases every time the jar is used.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Bethany
items.descriptionZh: 召唤具有不同泪弹效果的灵火，可射击、挡弹并造成接触伤害；每次使用生成的灵火数量递增。

items.description: Gives Isaac a permanent stat boost whenever he picks up a Soul Heart.
items.unlock: Defeat Ultra Greed as  Bethany
items.descriptionZh: 拾取魂心时永久提高一项属性。
items.unlockZh: 使用伯大尼击败究极贪婪。

items.description: Spawns a random friendly monster that mimics Isaac's movements and attacks.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Jacob and Esau
items.descriptionZh: 生成随机友方怪物，模仿角色的移动和攻击。
items.unlockZh: 使用雅各和以扫击败祸兽。

items.description: Upon death, Isaac respawns in the current room with half of a Red Heart, a massive size down, and +0.2 Speed.
items.unlock: Defeat Ultra Greed as  Jacob and Esau
items.descriptionZh: 死亡后原地以半颗红心复活，体型大幅缩小，移速 +0.2。
items.unlockZh: 使用雅各和以扫击败究极贪婪。

items.description: Item pedestals cycle between 5 random items before being picked up.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Tainted Isaac
items.descriptionZh: 道具底座在 5 个随机道具之间循环切换，拾取时获得当前显示的那个。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化以撒击败祸兽。

items.description: Causes enemies to bounce off of Isaac, dealing damage to them if they hit an enemy or obstacle. Also gives Isaac the chance to deflect enemy shots.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Tainted Magdalene
items.descriptionZh: 敌人撞到角色时会被弹开，撞到其他敌人或障碍物后受到伤害；也有概率弹开敌方弹幕。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化抹大拉击败祸兽。

items.description: Prevents items of quality 0-1 from appearing, and items of quality 2 from appearing 33% of the time. Quest items are unaffected.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Tainted Lost
items.descriptionZh: 阻止品质 0–1 的普通道具出现，品质 2 的道具也有 33% 概率被替换；任务道具不受影响。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化游魂击败祸兽。

items.description: Spawns a special set of spikes in the Devil Room. Taking damage from the spikes has a chance to grant a reward.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Tainted Judas
items.descriptionZh: 恶魔房内出现特殊地刺；在其上受伤有概率获得奖励。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化犹大击败祸兽。

items.description: Spawns eight orbital flies, which turn into Blue Flies after they block a shot. Each time a room is cleared, spawns another orbital fly.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Tainted ???
items.descriptionZh: 获得 8 只绕身苍蝇，挡下一发弹幕后变为蓝苍蝇；每清理一个房间增加一只绕身苍蝇。

items.description: Grants 3 broken hearts and +0.25 damage for every broken heart Isaac has. Every otherwise fatal hit will add 2 more until Isaac has nothing but broken hearts.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Tainted Eve
items.descriptionZh: 获得 3 颗碎心，每颗碎心使伤害 +0.25；原本致死的伤害改为增加 2 颗碎心，直到无法再承受为止。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化夏娃击败祸兽。

items.description: The first 6 times Isaac takes damage on a given floor, he gains Speed and Fire Rate for the rest of the floor, up to a maximum of +1.02 and +3.00, respectively.
items.unlock: Defeat Mother as  Samson
items.descriptionZh: 每层前 6 次受伤提高本层移速和射速，累计最多增加 1.02 移速、3 射速。

items.description: Gives Isaac a halo that summons beams of light on enemies inside it. The halo grows larger the more times Isaac has taken damage this floor.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Tainted Lazarus
items.descriptionZh: 获得能对范围内敌人召唤光柱的光环；本层受伤次数越多，光环越大。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化拉撒路击败祸兽。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that becomes a weaker clone of the floor's boss when entering the Boss Room. Defeating it drops an extra item.
items.unlock: Defeat Hush as  Jacob and Esau

items.unlockZh: 使用堕化拉撒路击败精神错乱。

items.descriptionZh: 获得在中等距离绕身飞行的攻击苍蝇，对接触的敌人持续造成伤害。

items.description: Spawns a fly familiar that moves in a straight line and circles around the first wall or obstacle it hits. It deals 105 damage per second on contact. It deals 56 damage per second and forces nearby enemies to attack it.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得贴着墙壁或障碍物绕行的苍蝇跟班，伤害接触的敌人，并吸引附近敌人攻击它。

items.description: +5 Bombs. Isaac's bombs explode into 2-4 tiny bombs.
items.quote: We put bombs in your bombs!
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得 5 枚炸弹；炸弹爆炸后分裂为 2–4 枚小炸弹。

items.description: +5 Bombs. Bombs stick to enemies and spawn 2-4 Blue Spiders if they kill an enemy. They also leave a long-lasting puddle of slowing white creep.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得 5 枚炸弹；炸弹会黏住敌人，击杀后生成 2–4 只蓝蜘蛛，并留下持续较久的白色减速液体。

items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 持续朝同一方向射击会平滑提高射速，不再分阶段跳升；停止射击或改变方向会重置增益。

items.description: Grants spectral tears and increases range. Tears travel through walls and appear at the opposite side of the room.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 获得幽灵泪弹并增加射程；泪弹穿过房间边界后，会从另一侧继续飞出。
