items.description: Spawns eight orbital flies, which turn into Blue Flies after they block a shot. Each time a room is cleared, spawns another orbital fly.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Tainted ???
items.descriptionZh: 获得 8 只绕身苍蝇，挡下一发弹幕后变为蓝苍蝇；每清理一个房间增加一只绕身苍蝇。

items.description: Grants 3 broken hearts and +0.25 damage for every broken heart Isaac has. Every otherwise fatal hit will add 2 more until Isaac has nothing but broken hearts.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Tainted Eve
items.descriptionZh: 获得 3 颗碎心，每颗碎心使伤害 +0.25；原本致死的伤害改为增加 2 颗碎心，直到无法再承受为止。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化夏娃击败祸兽。

items.description: The first 6 times Isaac takes damage on a given floor, he gains Speed and Fire Rate for the rest of the floor, up to a maximum of +1.02 and +3.00, respectively.
items.unlock: Defeat Mother as  Samson
items.descriptionZh: 每层前 6 次受伤提高本层移速和射速，累计最多增加 1.02 移速、3 射速。

items.description: Gives Isaac a halo that summons beams of light on enemies inside it. The halo grows larger the more times Isaac has taken damage this floor.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Tainted Lazarus
items.descriptionZh: 获得能对范围内敌人召唤光柱的光环；本层受伤次数越多，光环越大。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化拉撒路击败祸兽。

items.description: Spawns a familiar that becomes a weaker clone of the floor's boss when entering the Boss Room. Defeating it drops an extra item.
items.unlock: Defeat Hush as  Jacob and Esau
items.descriptionZh: 获得进入首领房后变为该首领弱化复制体的跟班；击败复制体可额外获得一个道具。
items.unlockZh: 使用雅各和以扫击败死寂。

items.description: Spawns two familiars that float on either side of Isaac and fire tears that use his tears, range, shot speed, and tear effects, and scale with damage.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Tainted Lilith
items.descriptionZh: 获得分居角色两侧的跟班，继承角色的射速、射程、弹速和泪弹效果，伤害随角色伤害变化。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化莉莉丝击败祸兽。

items.description: Isaac builds rage every time a room is cleared. After four rooms, fires a large Brimstone laser when entering the next room.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Tainted Azazel
items.descriptionZh: 每清理一个房间积累怒气；清理 4 个房间后，在进入下一个房间时发射巨型硫磺火激光。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化阿撒泻勒击败祸兽。

items.description: When Isaac uses a Card, Pill, or Rune, he also uses a copy of the previous three Cards/Pills/Runes he used after picking up Echo Chamber.
items.quote: I can see see the future future future
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Tainted Apollyon
items.descriptionZh: 使用卡牌、药丸或符文时，额外重放获得回声室后最近使用过的 3 个消耗品效果。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化亚玻伦击败祸兽。

items.description: Spawns an Old Chest at the start of each floor.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Tainted Forgotten
items.descriptionZh: 每层起始房间生成一个旧箱子。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化遗骸击败祸兽。

items.description: After taking damage, spawns an orbital wisp that lasts for the entire floor, up to a maximum of six. They fire tears but do not block shots.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Tainted Bethany
items.descriptionZh: 受伤后获得持续本层的绕身灵火，最多 6 个；它们可以射击，但不能挡弹。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化伯大尼击败祸兽。

items.description: Swaps between the current character and Esau Jr., who has +2 flat damage and flight. Characters have independent items and health. Dying as either character ends the run.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Tainted Jacob
items.descriptionZh: 在当前角色与小以扫之间切换；小以扫获得额外 2 点伤害和飞行。双方独立持有道具与生命，任意一方死亡都会结束本局。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化雅各击败祸兽。

items.description: Isaac goes berserk for 5 seconds, greatly increasing his speed, tears, and damage, but restricting him to using a melee weapon instead of his tears. This item charges by dealing damage to enemies instead of clearing rooms.
items.unlock: Defeat Delirium as  Tainted Samson
items.descriptionZh: 进入狂暴状态 5 秒，大幅提高移速、射速和伤害，但改为使用近战武器；通过造成伤害而非清房来充能。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化参孙击败精神错乱。

items.description: Briefly grants +1 speed and makes Isaac invulnerable and intangible. When the effect ends, destroys all projectiles and damages all enemies Isaac ran through.
items.unlock: Defeat Delirium as  Tainted Judas
items.descriptionZh: 短暂获得移速 +1、无敌与穿透能力；效果结束时摧毁穿过的弹幕，并伤害穿过的敌人。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化犹大击败精神错乱。

items.unlock: Defeat Delirium as  Tainted Apollyon
items.descriptionZh: 吞噬房间内的道具底座，为每件道具生成一只永久攻击蝗虫。基础伤害随被吞道具品质变化：Q0 为角色伤害的 0.5 倍，Q1 为 0.75 倍，Q2 为 1 倍，Q3 为 1.5 倍，Q4 为 2 倍；部分道具生成具有特殊能力的蝗虫。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化亚玻伦击败精神错乱。

items.description: Grants one full Red Heart container. Heals 1 additional Red Heart.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 增加 1 个填满的红心容器，额外恢复 1 颗红心。

items.description: +1 Damage. Prevents Isaac from firing tears from his left eye, like Cain.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 伤害 +1；左眼不再射击，类似该隐。

items.description: Isaac dashes forward and picks up the first enemy hit. After a moment, he slams them into the ground to deal damage and create a circular rock wave.
items.unlock: Defeat Delirium as  Jacob and Esau
items.descriptionZh: 向前冲刺并举起首个撞到的敌人，随后将其摔向地面，造成伤害和环形岩石冲击波。
items.unlockZh: 使用雅各和以扫击败精神错乱。

items.description: Collects and holds up to 8 pickups, which can then be used to craft an item. The power level of the item is based on the quality of pickups used.
items.unlock: Defeat Delirium as  Tainted Cain
items.descriptionZh: 收集最多 8 个掉落物作为材料，再将其合成为道具；材料品质影响可合成道具的强度。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化该隐击败精神错乱。

items.unlock: Defeat Delirium as  Tainted Lazarus
items.descriptionZh: 道具底座背后出现第二个幽灵道具，使用后交换实体与幽灵道具；堕化拉撒路使用时还会切换生死形态。 堕化拉撒路使用时只需 4 格充能，其他角色仍为 6 格。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化拉撒路击败精神错乱。

items.description: Spawns a wisp representing a random passive item, which orbits Isaac but can be destroyed. While the wisp is alive, Isaac gains that item's effects. Generation uses the current room's item pool 25% of the time, otherwise a random pool.
items.unlock: Defeat Delirium as  Tainted Bethany
items.descriptionZh: 生成代表随机被动道具的绕身灵火；灵火存活时获得该道具效果，灵火可被摧毁。部分生成会使用当前房间的道具池。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化伯大尼击败精神错乱。

items.description: Removes half a heart and creates a Clot familiar that mimics Isaac's movements and tear effects. As Tainted Eve, passively converts health into Clots while firing. Activating returns all Clots to health.
items.unlock: Defeat Delirium as  Tainted Eve
items.descriptionZh: 消耗半颗心生成模仿移动与泪弹效果的血块跟班；堕化夏娃射击时可持续生成血块，使用后将血块收回为生命。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化夏娃击败精神错乱。

items.description: Retrieves the Forgotten's body from any distance. Only available as the Birthright effect for Tainted Forgotten.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 从任意距离召回遗骸的身体；仅用于堕化遗骸的长子名分效果。

items.description: Exclusive to Tainted ???. Allows him to save one poop bomb for later, allowing him to gather more over time.
items.unlock: Unlocked by default (Available from the start)
items.descriptionZh: 堕化？？？专用，可暂存一个便便炸弹，留待之后使用。

items.description: Gives range, speed, or damage when buying things from a shop. Also spawns three coins and a Key on pickup.
items.unlock: Defeat Mother as  Keeper
items.descriptionZh: 购物时提高射程、移速或伤害；拾取时生成 3 枚硬币和 1 把钥匙。

items.description: Rocks and other Obstacles spawn blue spiders over time while in a room with enemies, and spawn two blue spiders when destroyed.
items.unlock: Defeat Delirium as  Tainted Keeper
items.descriptionZh: 战斗房间内，石头等障碍物会逐渐生成蓝蜘蛛；破坏它们时生成 2 只蓝蜘蛛。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化店主击败精神错乱。

items.description: Spawns a random shop item or pickup which can be bought for its normal price.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Keeper
items.descriptionZh: 生成一个按正常价格出售的随机商店道具或掉落物。

items.description: Spawns certain pickups based on how many charges it has. If fully charged, instead has one of many unique effects.
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Eden
items.descriptionZh: 按当前充能数量生成对应掉落物；满充能时改为随机触发一种特殊效果。

items.description: Causes all future items to be "glitched", granting them completely random effects.
items.quote: ZZaZZ ZZdZZiZZmZZhZZ ZZvZZ ZZoZZ ZZ ZZsZZlZZhZZsZZoZZaZZiZZ
items.unlock: Defeat The Beast as  Tainted Eden
items.descriptionZh: 后续道具变为乱码道具，并获得完全随机的效果。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化伊甸击败祸兽。

items.description: Chains down the nearest enemy for 5 seconds, preventing them from acting.
items.unlock: Defeat Delirium as  Tainted Jacob
items.descriptionZh: 束缚最近的敌人 5 秒，使其无法行动。
items.unlockZh: 使用堕化雅各击败精神错乱。
